english.note: Use 假期 as the all-purpose noun for time off, including a school break when no school-specific wording is needed.
This is the all-purpose choice for a period away from work or school, including an official break.
Use this when the recess is an official school or institutional holiday rather than a short break during an activity.

examples.english: We have a whole month of holiday in the summer, so we can travel.
examples.traditional: 我哋暑假有成個月假期，可以去旅行。
